rules: Offline evaluation is OOF only under AFAC_A2_FOLD_V1 with an explicit user order and explicit candidate set.
Test scores are never used as OOF, never averaged into offline metrics, and never guide candidate selection.
Assets are never selected by mtime or latest-file heuristics; only explicit, hash-verified assets qualify.
The online score (0.5093) is competition scalar feedback: usable for validation_calibration, direction_confidence, deployment_risk, submission_budgeting only.
Online feedback must never drive node-level correction, item-level correction, or test-label inference.
source_consensus_gate: A new score source may influence evaluation only after passing a consensus check against the frozen anchor sources.
